step.cmd: In FTS, determine if a request was sent to IPOC to stopped payment for the vacation in Canada issue:
In FTS, determine if there is a registration number for the vacation in Canada issue:

ul.li:
If no, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign a registration number as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised Decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operation Centre Memo (MM06) to advise IPOC to reinstate payment as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.
Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work Type: Select 30 - New information on a manual pay claim .
Remarks line 1: Type “Reinstate payments as of w/c [XXXX].”
Remarks line 2: Type “The client is entitled to collect benefits for the vacation in Canada period.”
Remarks line 3: Type your name and telephone number.

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
If it is a continuing claim, go to step 14.
If it is an initial or renewal claim, go to step 18.

step.cmd: Determine if there is an MA01 imposed for the out of Canada issue:

ul.li: If an MA01 is imposed but there is no registration number, go to step 15.
If an MA01 is imposed and there is a registration number, go to step 16.
If an MA01 is not imposed but there is a revised registration number, go to step 17.
If none of the above applies, go to step 18.

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.
Manual Action: Select 1 - General suspension of benefits (stop payment) .

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and clear the registration number as follows:
